clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money beginning in March 1988 and her distance from your father on money matters in May 1988, your grandfather's death in July 1989, your brother Felix's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990. The shifts pile up across more than a year with no long quiet between them, reaching from the money worry through the death and your brother's difficulty to your mother's return to steadier footing.
